title: Radio in a familiar language
description: Favorite stations, background playback and the timer gathered into a clear everyday path.

blocks.text: Away from home, familiar speech and an editor’s choice can matter to a person. Searching for the station every time gets in the way of that simple return.

quote.text: This app became my gateway into Russian radio, music, and even news in general. I listen not only to DFM Russian Dance, but also to many different Russian radio stations through the app.

blocks.text: Keep the stations and the settings, and show the state of the stream and the last choice. Think through the pause, the reconnection and the timer.
Availability depends on the station itself and on the terms of distribution. When a stream drops, what is needed is a clear status, not an endless promise of loading.
